steps.name: Einst's letter
steps.objective: Go to “Guild Union” and talk to Einst.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Oh, there you are. Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you call me for?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Oh my... , Are you asking straight to the point without even giving me a chance to say hello?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I feel like my personality has become a little impatient. I don't think it was this bad when I first saw it.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Then I'll tell you right away.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Aurora's forest manager and fairy, Flay, asked for my help. Somehow I got to know Fairy, and we maintained a close relationship for a long time.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Flyry, who rarely asks for help even when things are difficult, looks like she's going through something serious. I think it's because of Queen Aurora, the owner of the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is Queen Aurora?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: In a word, she is the queen of flowers who loves beautiful things.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: It can be said that it is a being born as a spirit and manages the forest while managing the fairies. There is a saying that in the pursuit of beauty, we overdo things a bit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, Zoe comes to mind….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. I will solve it.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You are confident.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Be careful when dealing with Queen Aurora.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: He just had a bit of an unusual personality, but he wasn't that nasty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: For more details, go to Aurora Forest and listen.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: There is a fairy, Flyly, at the entrance. When you visit, she will tell you in detail what is going on with Queen Aurora.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Ah, you can get to the Aurora Forest by going through the Coral Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything else I need to be careful about before going?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Hmm… . You can definitely ask Fairy Fly about that too. Well then, good luck. Have a nice trip.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, maybe I should just wish for luck?)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Anyway, the condition of Adventurer looks unstable, and I'm not sure if it's okay.

steps.name: To the Aurora forest!
steps.objective: Go to "Aurora Forest" and talk to Flari.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Hey, are you the one who came after listening to Einst? Adventurer… sir?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. You are Fairy Fly, right? I heard you asked Einst for help.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Ah, thank you. I waited. Thank you so much for coming all this way to ask for a favor from me, a person I don't even know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The road to the forest was a little rough, but I felt better once I got there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something makes me feel relaxed... .

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Right? Aurora Forest is truly the most peaceful place in the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … No, it's a little different than that... .

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Hmm? I don't know what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Fly is looking at him with a confident expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing. So how can I help you? Einst told me to go and listen first.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Ah, that means... .

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Okay, then I'll tell you. Aurora Forest is a space created by the power of Aurora, the queen of flowers.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: The forest residents decided to call this forest the Aurora Forest, hoping that it would last forever. Actually, the other name is so miserable... .

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Queen Aurora is a person who loves beautiful things and despises things that are unkempt.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: He had an arrogant personality and had a tendency to treat things he didn't like as stupid or ignore them.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: As long as there was no bumping into it, there was no problem. Actually, I rarely get to meet the Queen.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: But the queen started singing a song to ask what was going on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something wrong with the song?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: That's why you can't sing terribly. There are many people who can't sing. But that's not the Queen's problem. You have amazing vocal skills.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: It doesn't matter whether it's morning, evening, or dawn, it continues to call you whenever you are awake. It goes beyond the garden and fills the forest. It's enough to shake the forest.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: I guess you yourself don't know that. If you keep calling me... . Whoa, that song made everyone so stressed that they couldn't move properly.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Some residents have strange personalities... .

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Even good-natured unicorns are suffering from nervous breakdowns.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Really, God is doing too much. Why did you give Queen Aurora such vocal talent? Give me a tone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Fly seems very angry.)

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: For the sake of peace in the forest, we must stop singing Queen Aurora. Please help!

steps.name: If you do something wrong, you should be scolded.
steps.objective: Defeat [Queen Aurora] and report to Fly.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Please listen to me. Aurora.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Why on earth did you start singing a song you had no interest in before?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: (Aurora hesitates for a moment and then opens her mouth. It feels a little embarrassing to say this.)

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: It's because of one human man.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Yes? yes? Aurora is interested in someone else?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Oh my, oh my... . The queen doesn't care about anyone other than herself and treats men like mere servants? Also, humans?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: How could someone who doesn't even care about humans... .

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Well, stop it. It's noisy!! Me too, I didn't know that would happen.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: However, I couldn't help it because he was so cool, strong, and caring!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person is this that makes the queen so shaken?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: So. Who on earth is that guy? .

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: This is a man named Levi Ahrens. Do you know the Adventurer human there, Levi Ahrens?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's him?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Oh, you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, we know each other. Elias You work for the royal family of the kingdom.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Elias Kingdom?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is a kingdom on the continent of Gendia.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Gendia Continent, Elias Royal Guard Leader... . That's good information.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Thank you, I would like to go there later if I have a chance. Thanks, human Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how does Levy know the Queen? Is there any reason to come here?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: I don't know why he came here, but... . There was a time in the past when I went out to the forest for a while to run errands and ended up in danger.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: That person saved me then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Because when he sees someone in need, he doesn’t just pass them by.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: After that incident, I kept thinking about it. It's so strange to me to think of a human man.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Then, I remembered the melody the man was humming and started singing along.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: I thought that if I sang that song so well, I might be able to meet Levi Ahrens and sing it to him someday.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: I'm sorry. I thought it was just practice, but it was enough to shake the forest... .

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: It's okay. Aurora. If you started practicing singing because you fell in love with that human guy and wanted to impress him... well... .

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: If that's the case, can I help you?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: How are you going to help?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: I have a friend who sings well. There are a lot of people who sing well using that friend’s method.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: If it's a friend's lesson, even the queen will be able to do well.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: I believe that with the power the Queen has, she will be able to sing without damaging the gardens and forests.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Hmm, hmm. If you go that far, I'll put up with it.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Okay, so is it decided? Until then, please be patient with me singing.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: I will quickly invite a friend and let you know.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Hehe, Adventurer. Thank you so much! Thanks to you, things worked out well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad things ended well. Fly, please let Aurora know later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Levy likes people who are considerate more than people who sing well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Fly smiles and nods as if he understands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then should I go back now? But for some reason, I feel like I need to see Queen Aurora more often...)
